name: discord
description: Messages from the text channels of Discord servers that a bot of your own has been added to, read through Discord's official API. Read-only: it only ever asks Discord for messages and never posts.

secrets.name: token
secrets.help: Create a bot of your own at https://discord.com/developers/applications (New Application, then Bot), switch on "Message Content Intent" on its Bot page, add it to a server you run or may add bots to with only the View Channels and Read Message History permissions, and paste the bot's token when asked. Steps: extractors/discord/README.md. Never give it your personal account's token: that is against Discord's rules and gets accounts banned.
